text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've attracted a number of new supporters, including our most vocal critic. It turns out she has emotions she wants to convey to her fans as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The event we're planning will involve over 100,000 people, a number that sounds almost impossible. But it's beginning to feel more real by the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A call from the URA seals the deal—we officially have permission to hold the Grand Concert. Now to double down and make our vision a reality!
